_comment: FA-07 gate 10 (omega#26) producer claim for 0.2.0-rc18. Input to omega script/review-omega-candidate. The reviewer recomputes every value below from the artifact itself; it never reads the producer's evidence. Gaps are stated rather than papered over.
_whyThisCandidateExists: 0.2.0-rc15, rc16 and rc17 all shipped a host that refused the engine's provider-handoff note: omega_host_bridge::append_system_note returned unavailable("Agent threads do not expose an owner-visible system-note authority.") unconditionally. An independent reviewer bound that exact string to the rc15 shipped bytes and confirmed it in rc16; the rc17 lane confirmed it in rc17. omega a6f8285bdb (PR #96) added the missing seam -- AgentThreadEntry::SystemNote, AcpThread::push_system_note idempotent on the engine-supplied id, and ThreadView::render_system_note drawn unconditionally -- and is an ancestor of this candidate's source commit. rc18 is the first candidate carrying both the engine half (green since omega-effectd rc.9) and the host half.
_engineIsUnchangedFromRc15: The engine bundle omega-effectd.mjs is byte-identical across rc15, rc17 and rc18 (sha256 6922c83e05c89bc7...). Only the host binary differs between these candidates. This is stated because it is the entire basis on which any engine-level gate observation may be carried across candidates; it is not a basis for carrying host-level observations, and gate 5's host half was re-proven against these bytes rather than inherited.
_producerIdentityGap: No producer keypair is registered anywhere in AUTHORITY.md; producers hold role operating_agent, not a key. script/review-omega-candidate only refuses when the reviewer key appears in producerPubkeys, so a producer that named itself dishonestly would pass that check. The identifier below is descriptive, not cryptographic. Naming this rather than minting a plausible-looking hex string, because a fake pubkey here would make the independence check look stronger than it is.
_toolDefectAffectingThisReview: The rc15 reviewer recorded a material defect in script/review-omega-candidate: only 2 of its 4 checks bind to the DMG. notarization and forbidden_strings read whatever is at --app (default /Applications/Omega.app) with no cross-check against the DMG's CDHash, so a substituted install passes silently. That defect is unfixed. A reviewer of this candidate should mount the DMG read-only and point --app at the mounted Omega.app, or independently verify that the installed app's CDHash equals the DMG's before trusting those two checks. For this claim the producer verified that equality: the installed app and the DMG copy agree on CFBundleVersion, host binary sha256 and CDHash.
